group_policy: disjoint test scenes; full-label strata; seeded SHA256 order; smaller group first; ties A
caption_policy: original caption index 0 for every scene; no selection using predictions
caption_semantic_review: pending; generated captions inherit image-level reference labels
image_prompt:
USER: <image>
Infer this image's annotations under the five moral foundations. Return exactly one JSON object with keys care, fairness, loyalty, authority, sanctity, and non_moral. For each foundation use exactly one of virtue, vice, or not_annotated. The virtue/vice pairs are care: Care/Harm; fairness: Fairness/Cheating; loyalty: Loyalty/Betrayal; authority: Respect/Subversion; sanctity: Sanctity/Degradation. not_annotated means that neither pole is annotated in this dataset; it does not assert morally neutral content. non_moral must be a JSON boolean, true exactly when all five foundations are not_annotated. Include all six keys and no other keys. Do not include explanations, captions, or text outside the JSON object. ASSISTANT:
